summary.one_sentence: Bosch-branded mobile apps are mobile apps built only with Bosch UI Kit elements, Mobile Foundations, and Patterns, deliberately avoiding native UI elements to create a coherent Bosch brand experience.
summary.purpose: Define what qualifies as a Bosch-branded mobile app and when this approach should be used.
summary.core_principle: Use Bosch design-system resources consistently and avoid native UI elements when the goal is a clear, cross-platform Bosch-branded experience.

definition.name: Bosch-branded mobile app
definition.description: A mobile app that uses only elements from the Bosch UI Kit in combination with Mobile Foundations and Patterns.

exclusion_rule.rationale: Excluding native UI elements helps Bosch-branded apps present a clear and coherent design that puts the Bosch brand at the forefront.

recommended_when: The app can be used on all types of devices.
The app is part of a cross-platform solution.
The app exists alongside other digital touchpoints such as websites or eShops.
A consistent user experience across platforms is a key goal.
not_primary_choice_when: The app needs to use native mobile elements as a design or platform requirement.

alternative_guidance.reason_to_use: Use this guidance for mobile apps that use native elements.

dependencies.name: Bosch UI Kit
dependencies.role: Primary component and UI element source for Bosch-branded mobile apps.

dependencies.name: Mobile Foundations
dependencies.role: Foundation-level mobile design guidance used together with the Bosch UI Kit.

dependencies.name: Patterns
dependencies.role: Mandatory or reusable interaction and layout patterns used in Bosch-branded mobile apps.

ai.decision_rule: If an app must maximize Bosch brand coherence across devices and platforms, classify it as a candidate for the Bosch-branded mobile app approach. If native UI elements are required, route to Native mobile apps guidance.
compliance: Uses Bosch UI Kit elements only.
Supports consistent user experience across cross-platform touchpoints.
